meta.description: A catalog of films, series, and anime with direct links to official providers. Fast, light, mobile-first.

home.title: Watch without the fuss.
home.body: A catalog of films, series, and anime with links to official providers. Layout, navigation, and i18n are live; catalog data lands in Phase 3.
home.emptyBody: The TMDB sync runs in Phase 3. Meanwhile, navigation, theme, and language are ready to test.

film.title: Movies
film.body: Movie browse shell. Grid, filters, and pagination come online with the TMDB adapter.

series.title: Series
series.body: Series browse shell. Episode lists follow with the TMDB adapter.

anime.title: Anime
anime.body: Anime browse shell. The AniList source is optional and scheduled for Phase 4.

trending.title: Trending
trending.body: Cross-source ranking. Score blends popularity, rating, and recency.

new.title: New releases
new.body: Latest releases across every source, ordered by air date.

search.title: Search
search.body: Cross-source search with a 300 ms debounce and keyboard navigation. The endpoint lands in Phase 6.

watch.title: Watch
watch.body: Watch shell. HLS player for owned content, official trailers, and provider links arrive in Phase 5.

genre.title: Genre
genre.body: Cross-source genre page. The fixed genre set is seeded in Phase 2.

person.title: Person
person.body: Cast and crew page. Populated from TMDB credits in Phase 3.

history.title: History
history.body: Watch history stays on this device. No account, no server sync.

library.title: Saved
library.body: Saved titles live in localStorage. Fully wired in Phase 6.

playlist.title: Playlist
playlist.body: Local playlists for lining up what to watch next. Fully wired in Phase 6.

dmca.title: DMCA
dmca.body: ONGX hosts no video files. The full takedown procedure and contact address are written in Phase 12.

about.title: About
about.body: ONGX is a discovery catalog. Metadata comes from TMDB and AniList; playback happens on official providers.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Official contact channels will be listed here in Phase 12.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: The full privacy policy, including third-party ad cookies, is written in Phase 12.

terms.title: Terms
terms.body: Terms of service are written in Phase 12.

footer.attribution: Film, series, and anime metadata provided by TMDB and AniList. ONGX does not host or stream video files.
footer.tmdbNotice: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: The page failed to load. Try again, or head back home.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may have changed, or the content is not available yet.
